identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase III, Open-label, Multicenter Trial of Avelumab (MSB0010718C) Versus Platinum-based Doublet as a First-line Treatment of Recurrent or Stage IV PD-L1+NSCLC

interventions.name: Avelumab
interventions.description: Participants received Avelumab at a dose of 10 milligrams per kilogram (mg/kg) as a 1-hour (-10/+20 minutes) intravenous (IV) infusion once every 2 weeks until disease progression or unacceptable toxicities.

interventions.name: Pemetrexed
interventions.description: Participants received Pemetrexed 500 milligrams per square meter (mg/m\^2) by IV infusion on Day 1 of 3-Week cycle up to a maximum of 6 cycles of IV injection until disease progression or unacceptable toxicities.

interventions.name: Paclitaxel
interventions.description: Participants received Paclitaxel 200 mg/m\^2 by IV infusion on Day 1 of 3-Week cycle up to a maximum of 6 cycles of IV injection until disease progression or unacceptable toxicities.

interventions.name: Gemcitabine
interventions.description: Participants received Gemcitabine 1250 mg/m\^2 on Day 1 and Day 8 by IV infusion in 3-Week cycle up to a maximum of 6 cycles when combined with cisplatin of IV injection until disease progression or unacceptable toxicities.

interventions.name: Gemcitabine
interventions.description: Participants received Gemcitabine 1000 mg/m\^2 on Day 1 and Day 8 by IV infusion in 3-Week cycle up to a maximum of 6 cycles of IV injection when combined with carboplatin until disease progression or unacceptable toxicities.

interventions.name: Carboplatin
interventions.description: Participants received Carboplatin area under concentration curve (AUC) 5 mg/mL\*min in 3-Week cycle up to a maximum of 6 cycles of IV injection when combined with gemcitabine until disease progression or unacceptable toxicities.

interventions.name: Cisplatin
interventions.description: Participants received Cisplatin 75 mg/m\^2 by IV infusion in 3-Week cycle up to a maximum of 6 cycles of IV injection until disease progression or unacceptable toxicities.

interventions.name: Carboplatin
interventions.description: Carboplatin AUC 6 mg/mL\*min by IV infusion in 3-Week cycle up to a maximum of 6 cycles of IV injection when combined with pemetrexed, or paclitaxel until disease progression or unacceptable toxicities.

interventions.name: Avelumab Weekly
interventions.description: Participants received Avelumab at a dose of 10 mg/kg as a 1-hour (-10/+20 minutes) IV infusion every week for 12 consecutive weeks.
